name: vscode-emulator-run
description: Run a Flutter app on a remote emulator/simulator. Picks a device, runs `flutter run` locally, then launches the EmulatorDesktopApp to display the live stream. VS Code owns the lifecycle from the Run/Debug controls; the desktop app owns the streaming.

commands.title: Emulator Stream: Run Flutter on remote device

emulatorStreamRun.server.description: WebSocket URL of the emulator gateway server. (Prefer 127.0.0.1 over localhost — Node 18+ resolves 'localhost' to IPv6 first, which fails against IPv4-only servers.)

emulatorStreamRun.desktopAppPath.description: Advanced: absolute path to the EmulatorDesktopApp binary. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension (recommended).

emulatorStreamRun.flutterProject.description: Path to the Flutter project (containing pubspec.yaml). Empty means use the workspace root.

emulatorStreamRun.openStreamWindow.description: Launch the EmulatorDesktopApp streaming window when the app starts. Disable to only run Flutter locally without streaming.

emulatorStreamRun.stopGracePeriodMs.description: How long to wait for Flutter to exit gracefully after sending the 'q' quit command before SIGTERM.

server.description: WebSocket URL of the emulator gateway server (overrides emulatorStreamRun.server).

device.description: Device id to launch on. If omitted, a Quick Pick is shown. If exactly one device is available, it is auto-selected.

flutterProject.description: Absolute path to the Flutter project (containing pubspec.yaml). Falls back to the workspace root.

target.description: Passed to Flutter as --target (Dart entry point, e.g. lib/main_dev.dart).

flutterArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to `flutter run` (e.g. ["--dart-define=FOO=bar"]).

openStreamWindow.description: Launch the EmulatorDesktopApp after Flutter reports the app started.

configName.description: Reuse a Flutter flavor already defined in this workspace. Matches by name against `type: "dart"` configs in launch.json (and against lib/main_*.dart filenames). Missing target/flavor/args are inherited from the matched config.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pick device + flavor
configurationSnippets.description: Prompts a flavor + device Quick Pick, runs Flutter, launches the streaming window.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: reuse a Dart flavor by name
configurationSnippets.description: Inherits target/flavor/args from an existing `type: "dart"` config with the same name.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: specific device + flavor
configurationSnippets.description: Skip the pickers by pinning both a device id and a flavor.
